title: Stable influence at the matching parameter
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose values lie in $[-1,1]$. The stable influences of $f$ at noise parameter $1-\varepsilon$ are all at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if, for every coordinate $i$, the sum over all subsets $S$ containing $i$ of $(1-\varepsilon)^{|S|-1}$ times the square of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to $\mathbb R$
